name: player_offensive_archetypes
description: Offense-ONLY player play-style archetype (the counterpart to player_archetypes above) - one row per player-season (same games/minutes floor, plus total_fga >= 50), enriched with real shot-location data (player_shot_zone_features) and alley-oop rate/efficiency mined directly from play_by_play. No defensive stats (stl/blk/reb) at all, by design. K-means (k=9) on standardized shape features. No tier layer yet (built after this table, if wanted). See models/build_offensive_archetypes.R.

name: player_id
description: Player's NBA Stats API identifier.

name: player_name
description: Player's full name.

name: season
description: Season string, e.g. '2022-23'.
logic: Set explicitly to the season being pulled, not trusted from the API's own inconsistently-typed season field - see R/pull_schedule.R.

name: games_played
description: Games played this player-season (season-total grain, not rolling).

name: min_per_game
description: Average minutes played per game this player-season.

name: total_fga
description: Total field goal attempts this player-season, summed across the 8 shot zones - the denominator for every *_share column in this table.
logic: Sum of fga_<zone> across all 8 zones.

name: archetype_cluster
description: Which k-means cluster this player-season was assigned to (an arbitrary integer, not itself meaningful - see archetype_label for the human-readable name). Fit on standardized shape features via models/build_player_archetypes.R or models/build_offensive_archetypes.R depending on the table.

name: archetype_label
description: Human-assigned name for this player-season's archetype_cluster, chosen after reviewing real centroid profiles and sample rosters - never pre-decided before seeing the actual clustering output.
logic: Manual lookup from CLUSTER_LABELS in the build script.

name: restricted_area_share
description: Share of this player-season's total FGA taken from the restricted area (within 4ft of the hoop).

name: paint_share
description: Share of total FGA taken from the paint, excluding the restricted area.

name: mid_range_share
description: Share of total FGA that were mid-range shots (left + center + right mid-range zones combined).

name: corner_3_share
description: Share of total FGA that were corner 3s (left + right corner combined).

name: above_the_break_3_share
description: Share of total FGA that were above-the-break 3s.

name: restricted_area_fg_pct
description: Field goal percentage on restricted-area attempts this player-season - a rim-finishing skill marker, included as a clustering input the same way efg_pct is in the combined archetype system.

name: three_pt_fg_pct
description: Field goal percentage on all 3-point attempts (corner + above-the-break combined) this player-season.

name: alley_oop_rate
description: Share of total FGA that were alley-oops (dunk or layup) - the 'lob threat' signal. Not tracked anywhere else in this pipeline; mined directly from play_by_play type_text.
sources: play_by_play.type_text (Alley Oop Dunk/Layup Shot, Running variants)

name: alley_oop_fg_pct
description: Conversion rate on alley-oop attempts this player-season.

name: fta_rate
description: Free throw attempts relative to field goal attempts this player-season.

name: oreb_share
description: Share of this player's own total rebounds that were offensive this player-season.

name: ast_to_tov
description: Assist-to-turnover ratio this player-season (capped at 10 before clustering).

name: ast_per36
description: Assists per 36 minutes this player-season.

name: pts_per36
description: Points per 36 minutes this player-season.

name: tov_per36
description: Turnovers per 36 minutes this player-season.
